conceptual_change: Introduce an engine-level volatility filter that disables entry signals whenever the 14-period ATR is less than or equal to 1.5 times the 20-period moving average of the ATR.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected due to lack of an explicit engine implementation. This hypothesis formalizes the volatility gate as an engine-level execution rule to ensure testability within the existing simulation environment.
